scientific_integrity: The detailed graph assertions are analytic, with exactly stated exceptional case, and independently unaudited; source algorithms and classical spectral identities are credited. Historical priority beyond checked sources is uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected connected positively weighted graphs, uniform killing, and finite one-old-state coordinatewise residual multipliers; local order for all strictly positive states only. No nonlinear or global order claim, and finite diagnostics are not infinite proof.
title: Frozen-coordinate order barriers for graph diffusion: a sharp spectral-variance classification
